list.name: indicator_type
list.label: Type
list.query: Indicator (1) : 1, Reference value / spread (0) : 0, Currency type (3) : 3

list.name: asset
list.label: Asset
list.query:
SELECT asset
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_indicator_instruments/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE indicator_type_code IN ($indicator_type)
  AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY asset
ORDER BY count(DISTINCT instrument_id) DESC, asset
LIMIT 1000
list.definition:

panels.title: Indicator instruments
panels.description: Indicator instruments of the selected assets and types on the latest day in the range.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_indicator_instruments/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE asset IN ($asset)
    AND indicator_type_code IN ($indicator_type)
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT count(*)::BIGINT AS instruments
FROM d
WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d)

panels.title: Added in range
panels.description: Indicator instruments of the selected assets that appeared vs the previous trading day, summed over the range.

targets.rawSql:
WITH days AS (
  SELECT trad_dt,
    lag(trad_dt) OVER (ORDER BY trad_dt) AS prev_dt,
    lead(trad_dt) OVER (ORDER BY trad_dt) AS next_dt
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT trad_dt
    FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_indicator_instruments/daily_parse/*.parquet')
    WHERE trad_dt::TIMESTAMP >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL 10 DAY
    AND trad_dt::TIMESTAMP <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP
  )
),
d AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, asset, instrument_id, description, indicator_description
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_indicator_instruments/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE asset IN ($asset)
    AND indicator_type_code IN ($indicator_type)
    AND trad_dt::TIMESTAMP >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL 10 DAY
    AND trad_dt::TIMESTAMP <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP
),
r AS (
  SELECT d.*, days.prev_dt, days.next_dt,
    lag(d.trad_dt) OVER w AS inst_prev,
    lead(d.trad_dt) OVER w AS inst_next
  FROM d JOIN days ON days.trad_dt = d.trad_dt
  WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY d.instrument_id ORDER BY d.trad_dt)
),
ev AS (
  SELECT trad_dt AS dt, 'added' AS change, asset, description, indicator_description, 1 AS added, 0 AS removed
  FROM r
  WHERE prev_dt IS NOT NULL AND inst_prev IS DISTINCT FROM prev_dt
  UNION ALL
  SELECT next_dt, 'removed', asset, description, indicator_description, 0, 1
  FROM r
  WHERE next_dt IS NOT NULL AND inst_next IS DISTINCT FROM next_dt
)
SELECT coalesce(sum(added), 0)::BIGINT AS added
FROM ev
WHERE $__timeFilter(dt::TIMESTAMP)

panels.title: Latest trading day
panels.description: Most recent trading day with data for the selected assets in the range.

targets.rawSql:

FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_indicator_instruments/daily_parse/*.parquet')

panels.title: Indicator instruments per asset
panels.description: Daily number of indicator instruments per selected asset.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, asset, count(*)::BIGINT AS instruments
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_indicator_instruments/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE asset IN ($asset)
  AND indicator_type_code IN ($indicator_type)
  AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY time, asset

panels.title: Change since start of range
panels.description: Indicator instruments minus each asset's count on its first day in the range.

targets.rawSql:
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, asset, count(*)::BIGINT AS instruments
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_indicator_instruments/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE asset IN ($asset)
    AND indicator_type_code IN ($indicator_type)
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT time, asset, instruments - first_value(instruments) OVER (PARTITION BY asset ORDER BY time) AS change
FROM daily
ORDER BY time, asset

panels.title: Growth since start of range
panels.description: Indicator instruments relative to each asset's count on its first day in the range.

targets.rawSql:
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, asset, count(*)::BIGINT AS instruments
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_indicator_instruments/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE asset IN ($asset)
    AND indicator_type_code IN ($indicator_type)
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT time, asset, instruments / nullif(first_value(instruments) OVER (PARTITION BY asset ORDER BY time), 0) - 1 AS growth
FROM daily
ORDER BY time, asset

panels.title: Daily net change
panels.description: Indicator instruments vs the previous trading day's count, per selected asset.

targets.rawSql:
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, asset, count(*)::BIGINT AS instruments
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_indicator_instruments/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE asset IN ($asset)
    AND indicator_type_code IN ($indicator_type)
    AND trad_dt::TIMESTAMP >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL 10 DAY
    AND trad_dt::TIMESTAMP <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP
  GROUP BY ALL
),
changes AS (
  SELECT time, asset, instruments - lag(instruments) OVER (PARTITION BY asset ORDER BY time) AS change
  FROM daily
)
SELECT time, asset, change
FROM changes
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  AND change IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY time, asset

panels.title: Share of all indicator instruments
panels.description: Each selected asset's share of all indicator instruments of the selected types per day.

targets.rawSql:
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, asset, count(*)::BIGINT AS instruments
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_indicator_instruments/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE indicator_type_code IN ($indicator_type)
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT time, asset, share
FROM (
  SELECT time, asset, instruments / sum(instruments) OVER (PARTITION BY time) AS share
  FROM daily
)
WHERE asset IN ($asset)
ORDER BY time, asset

panels.title: Indicator instruments by type
panels.description: Daily indicator instruments of the selected assets per indicator type code, stacked; ignores the type filter.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE indicator_type_code = '1')::BIGINT AS "Indicator (1)",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE indicator_type_code = '0')::BIGINT AS "Reference value / spread (0)",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE indicator_type_code = '3')::BIGINT AS "Currency type (3)"

WHERE asset IN ($asset)
  AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Selected assets (range)
panels.description: Indicator instrument counts per selected asset at the start and end of the range, with the codes they use.

targets.rawSql:
WITH b AS (
  SELECT min(trad_dt) AS first_day, max(trad_dt) AS last_day
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_indicator_instruments/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
),
d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_indicator_instruments/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE asset IN ($asset)
    AND indicator_type_code IN ($indicator_type)
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT
  asset,
  arg_max(instrument_name, trad_dt) AS instrument_name,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE trad_dt = b.first_day)::BIGINT AS at_start,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE trad_dt = b.last_day)::BIGINT AS latest,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE trad_dt = b.last_day)::BIGINT - count(*) FILTER (WHERE trad_dt = b.first_day)::BIGINT AS net_change,
  count(DISTINCT instrument_id)::BIGINT AS seen_in_range,
  count(DISTINCT trad_dt)::BIGINT AS days,
  string_agg(DISTINCT indicator_type_code, ', ' ORDER BY indicator_type_code) AS type_codes,
  string_agg(DISTINCT base_code, ', ' ORDER BY base_code) AS base_codes,
  string_agg(DISTINCT decimal_precision::VARCHAR, ', ' ORDER BY decimal_precision::VARCHAR) AS decimal_precisions
FROM d, b
GROUP BY asset
ORDER BY latest DESC, asset

SELECT asset,

  instrument_id::VARCHAR AS instrument_id,
  indicator_type_code,

  value_type_code,
  entry_reference_code,
  decimal_precision,
  maturity_code
FROM d
WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d)
ORDER BY asset, description

panels.title: Code distribution (latest day in range)
panels.description: Indicator instruments of the selected assets per combination of type, base, value type, maturity and entry reference codes.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_indicator_instruments/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE asset IN ($asset)
    AND indicator_type_code IN ($indicator_type)
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT
  indicator_type_code AS type,
  base_code AS base,
  value_type_code AS value_type,
  maturity_code AS maturity,
  entry_reference_code AS entry_ref,
  count(*)::BIGINT AS instruments,
  count(DISTINCT asset)::BIGINT AS assets,
  string_agg(DISTINCT asset, ', ' ORDER BY asset) AS asset_list
FROM d
WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d)
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY instruments DESC

panels.title: Assets with most indicators (latest day in range)
panels.description: Top 20 assets by indicator instruments on the latest day in the selected types; ignores the asset filter.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_indicator_instruments/daily_parse/*.parquet')

FROM d

panels.title: $asset indicators (range)
panels.description: Indicator instruments of one selected asset with first and last day seen in the range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  description,
  any_value(indicator_description) AS indicator_description,
  any_value(indicator_type_code) AS type,
  any_value(base_code) AS base,
  any_value(decimal_precision) AS decimals,
  strftime(min(trad_dt), '%Y-%m-%d') AS first_seen,
  strftime(max(trad_dt), '%Y-%m-%d') AS last_seen,
  count(DISTINCT trad_dt)::BIGINT AS days
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_indicator_instruments/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE asset = $asset
  AND indicator_type_code IN ($indicator_type)
  AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY description
ORDER BY max(trad_dt) DESC, min(trad_dt) DESC, description

    FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_indicator_instruments/daily_parse/*.parquet')
    WHERE trad_dt::TIMESTAMP >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL 10 DAY
    AND trad_dt::TIMESTAMP <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP
  )
),
d AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, asset, instrument_id, description, indicator_description
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_indicator_instruments/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE asset = $asset
    AND indicator_type_code IN ($indicator_type)
    AND trad_dt::TIMESTAMP >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL 10 DAY
    AND trad_dt::TIMESTAMP <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP
),
r AS (
  SELECT d.*, days.prev_dt, days.next_dt,
    lag(d.trad_dt) OVER w AS inst_prev,
    lead(d.trad_dt) OVER w AS inst_next
  FROM d JOIN days ON days.trad_dt = d.trad_dt
  WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY d.instrument_id ORDER BY d.trad_dt)
),
ev AS (
  SELECT trad_dt AS dt, 'added' AS change, asset, description, indicator_description, 1 AS added, 0 AS removed
  FROM r
  WHERE prev_dt IS NOT NULL AND inst_prev IS DISTINCT FROM prev_dt
  UNION ALL
  SELECT next_dt, 'removed', asset, description, indicator_description, 0, 1
  FROM r
  WHERE next_dt IS NOT NULL AND inst_next IS DISTINCT FROM next_dt
)
,
cnt AS (
  SELECT trad_dt AS dt, count(*)::BIGINT AS n
  FROM d
  GROUP BY trad_dt
)
SELECT
  days.trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time,
  coalesce(cnt.n, 0)::BIGINT AS "Instruments",
  coalesce(sum(ev.added), 0)::BIGINT AS "Added",
  coalesce(sum(ev.removed), 0)::BIGINT AS "Removed"
FROM days
LEFT JOIN cnt ON cnt.dt = days.trad_dt
LEFT JOIN ev ON ev.dt = days.trad_dt
WHERE $__timeFilter(days.trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY days.trad_dt, cnt.n
ORDER BY time
